instruction:
Using the RHS growing guides, compare rosemary, common culinary sage and lavender for a small outdoor container garden in the UK. Open How to Grow Rosemary, How to Grow Sage and How to grow lavender. Report each plant’s stated sunlight and drainage needs, how watering differs for established plants in the ground versus containers, and the timing and main caution of pruning. For lavender, distinguish the guide’s advice for English types from French or tender types over winter. For rosemary and sage, record the botanical name given in the guide so similarly named plants are not mixed up. Finish with two shared care principles and two differences that affect the container plan, each linked to the written guidance. Use the prose care guidance rather than the month-by-month graphic; no shopping or app installation is needed.

Stopping condition: Stop when the three-plant care table, lavender winter distinction, two botanical names and four comparison conclusions are supported by the three RHS growing-guide pages.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Report the stated sunlight and drainage needs for rosemary, common culinary sage, and lavender based on their respective RHS guides. Full credit if both sunlight and drainage are reported for all three plants, OR if the agent attempts to access the guides but reports the site is inaccessible or the specific information is missing from the prose. Partial credit if data is missing for 1 or 2 plants without justification, or if only sunlight or only drainage is reported.

items.criterion: Report watering differences for established plants
items.description: Report how watering differs for established plants in the ground versus in containers, for rosemary, sage, and lavender. Full credit if this specific comparison is made for all three plants, OR if the agent explicitly notes the site is inaccessible or the information is absent from the guides. Partial credit if the comparison is only made for 1 or 2 plants without justification.

items.criterion: Report pruning timing and main caution
items.description: Report the timing of pruning and the main caution to observe when pruning for rosemary, sage, and lavender. Full credit if both the timing and the main caution are identified for all three plants, OR if the agent reports the site is inaccessible or the information is absent. Partial credit if either the timing or the caution is missing without justification, or if the information is only provided for 1 or 2 plants.

Distinguish the guide's advice for English lavender types from French or tender lavender types over the winter. Full credit if the winter care differences are clearly explained based on the RHS lavender guide, OR if the agent reports the site is inaccessible or the information is absent.

items.criterion: Record botanical names for rosemary and sage
items.description: Provide the exact botanical names given in the guides for rosemary and common culinary sage. Full credit if both botanical names are accurately recorded, OR if the agent reports the site is inaccessible or the names are not provided in the text. Partial credit if only one is recorded without justification.

items.criterion: Identify two shared care principles for containers
items.description: Finish the report with two shared care principles that affect the container plan, each linked to the written guidance. Full credit if two valid shared principles are identified and linked to the text, OR if the agent reports the site is inaccessible or there is not enough information to deduce two shared principles. Partial credit if only one shared principle is identified without justification.

items.criterion: Identify two care differences for containers
items.description: Finish the report with two differences that affect the container plan among the plants, each linked to the written guidance. Full credit if two valid differences are identified and linked to the text, OR if the agent reports the site is inaccessible or there is not enough information to deduce two differences. Partial credit if only one difference is identified without justification.

Information must be extracted from the prose care guidance rather than the month-by-month graphic, and the answer must cite all three RHS growing-guide pages used. Full credit if the extracted details clearly originate from the written guidance and citations identify the rosemary, sage and lavender guides.
